svg.aria-label: the layers of multi-hardware support: the engine's logic stays the same, and the Platform class gathers differences like device names, communication backends, attention backends and graph modes into a plugin
svg.text: the Platform abstraction: device_type, dispatch_key, collectives, visible devices, attention backend selection
platform plugins: CUDA / ROCm / XPU / Ascend (vllm-ascend)
kernels: FlashAttention / aiter / Ascend attention; MoE, quantization, graph modes
onboarding new hardware: Platform's dozens of hooks, attention and MoE kernels, a communication backend (HCCL / RCCL / XCCL), a graph mode
the big difference is kernel coverage and performance, not surface attributes: without matching fused kernels the same engine can be several times slower
